alternatives.mechanism: Human‑in‑the‑loop condition verification where team members manually confirm or update condition status via a lightweight UI, optionally assisted by AI‑suggested change indicators.
addresses_issues: Programmatic detection of condition changes is often infeasible due to ambiguous or qualitative criteria.
Alert fatigue may cause users to ignore or disable notifications.
User adoption is uncertain; teams may not consistently log decisions.
tradeoffs: Requires extra manual effort and may delay detection of critical changes
Relies on user discipline, risk of missed updates
Adds UI complexity that could affect onboarding
alternatives.novelty_or_difference: Shifts from fully automated monitoring to collaborative verification, turning ambiguous criteria into explicit human judgments.

alternatives.mechanism: Configurable, tiered alert system with digest mode and qualitative tags, letting users set per‑decision alert thresholds, group notifications, and choose summary digests.
addresses_issues: Alert fatigue may cause users to ignore or disable notifications.
Programmatic detection of condition changes is often infeasible due to ambiguous or qualitative criteria.
User adoption is uncertain; teams may not consistently log decisions.
tradeoffs: Potential delay in urgent alerts when digest mode is used
alternatives.novelty_or_difference: Empowers users to control alert granularity and use qualitative tags instead of strict programmatic rules.

alternatives.mechanism: Client‑side encrypted storage of decision rationales with role‑based access and zero‑knowledge proof, keeping sensitive information confidential while allowing metadata‑based search.
addresses_issues: Storing decision rationales may expose sensitive business information.
User adoption is uncertain; teams may not consistently log decisions.
tradeoffs: Adds encryption/decryption overhead and key‑management responsibilities
Limits full‑text search capabilities, relying on metadata
alternatives.novelty_or_difference: Introduces privacy‑preserving encryption that protects business‑critical rationales without sacrificing auditability.
